p: hearkened unto your voice in all: I have granted your petition.
before you: To govern you in peace and war.
whose ox have I taken: God would have this confession be a pattern for all who have any charge or office.
anointed is witness this day: Your King, who is anointed by the commandment of the Lord.
captain of the host of Hazor: Captain of Jabin's host, king of Hazor.
and Bedan: That is Samson, Jud 13:25.
Nay: Leaving God to seek the help of man, 1Sa 8:5.
following the LORD your God: You shall be preserved as they that follow the Lord's will.
great: In that you have forsaken him, who has all power in his hand, for a mortal man.
all our sins this evil: Not only at other times, but now chiefly.
yet turn not aside from following: He shows that there is no sin so great, but it shall be forgiven, if the sinner turn again to God.
his people: Of his free mercy, and not of your merits, and therefore he will not forsake you.
